rationale: B consistently reacts to external events and shifts focus sensibly: leans in after TOUCH (t=8), returns gaze on CALL (t=20), orients to OFFER_FOOD (t=32), attends PRESENT_OBJECT:PLAY_BALL (t=44), and withdraws on STARTLE (t=68), later resuming play (t=78).
